# Modliq

Modliq is a manufacturing intelligence product by Qeltrava AI, built in Tamil Nadu, India.

Website: https://modliq-io.vercel.app/
Parent company: Qeltrava AI
Parent website: https://qeltravaai.vercel.app/en
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/qeltravai/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/qeltravaai

Modliq helps manufacturers upload or connect production data, check dataset readiness, optimize process settings, validate quality with SPC and Cp/Cpk, track OEE and supplier risk, manage lean actions, and generate buyer-ready Quality Passports.

Primary audience:
- Manufacturing companies
- Indian MSME manufacturers
- Plant heads
- Quality managers
- Process engineers
- Operations managers
- Supplier quality teams
- Lean and continuous improvement teams

Core features:
- CSV and Excel data ingestion
- PDF and Word reference documents
- Supabase/Postgres and MongoDB connectors
- Dataset health scoring
- Natural language goal parsing
- Review and Confirm setup wizard
- ML process optimization
- Quality Studio with SPC, Cp/Cpk, and AQL
- OEE and operations intelligence
- Supplier and material lot traceability
- Lean and Kaizen tracking
- AI Copilot for explanation and documentation
- Quality Passport for buyer-ready reporting

Important safety note:
Modliq provides decision-support recommendations based on user-provided data. It does not guarantee production outcomes, buyer approval, audit certification, or regulatory compliance. All process changes should be validated through controlled trials and responsible engineering review.
